items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: The only thing that sounded any good was Sing, the piano player. Sing Melo? Yeah, he sounded pretty good.

ctx.x: What about the Harmony and what was that like?
Oh it was just dance music. It wasn't really jazz. The only thing that sounded any good was Sing, the piano player. Sing Melo? Yeah, he sounded pretty good.
Yeah, I like his playing too.
